title: Multi-Flag Constraint Injection
statement: Read a base instruction, then a line with three space-separated flags 'true'/'false' in this fixed order: require_json, be_concise, no_opinions. Print the instruction on the first line. If at least one flag is true, follow it with a line 'Constraints:' and then a numbered list (starting at 1, renumbered sequentially, only for the active flags, in the fixed order above) using these exact texts: 'Respond with valid JSON only.', 'Be concise.', 'Do not include opinions.'. If no flags are true, print only the instruction line.
starter_code:
instruction = input()
flags = input().split()
require_json = flags[0] == 'true'
be_concise = flags[1] == 'true'
no_opinions = flags[2] == 'true'
